item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-15/历史在此重演-利用原生重放释放线性注意力的百万长上下文能力/
item.description:
在长上下文语言建模 (Long-Context Language Modeling) 领域，以线性注意力 (Linear Attention) 为代表的循环神经网络架构凭借优越的推理计算效率被寄予厚望；然而受限于固定尺寸的循环隐状态，模型既要在自回归过程中维系每一步的前向计算，又不得不设法容纳无限延伸的历史信息，极易在处理超长文本时遭遇严重的“记忆遗忘”。学术界此前普遍认为，正是这种状态容量的物理天花板锁死了线性注意力的长上下文扩展上限。针对这一核心瓶颈，Li Nanbo 与 Jürgen Schmidhuber 等研究人员提出了创新的 **NoteBank** 框架，打破了“循环计算必须孤身背负长时记忆全部负担”的传统定势——它构建了一种稀疏情境记忆 (Sparse Episodic Memory) 体系，在未知未来提问的情况下预先归档高价值文本，并直接复用主干网络的原生特征进行写入与寻址，最终借助“原生重放 (Native Replay) ”在前向计算中直接阅读并召回关键事实证据。这项免训练、即插即用的方案在高达 100 万 Token 的严苛评估下，将 Gated DeltaNet 在 RULER 检索基准上的平均准确率从濒临失效的 1.7% 跨越式提升至 70.3%，且在 4K 到 1M 的超大跨度内几乎没有出现检索衰退。尤为难能可贵的是，该方法仅引入了极小的计算开销 (理论分析浮点运算量 FLOPs 增幅 $\leqslant$0.025%) ，持久化上下文存储需求更是仅为传统 Transformer 完整多头注意力键值缓存 (KV Cache) 的约 1/2,600，为极低代价实现百万级长上下文能力提供了全新的技术突破口。
---
## 内容概要
> ## Summary
线性注意力模型凭借卓越的计算效率，一直被视为长上下文语言建模的理想方案；然而在传统实践中，它们往往陷入左右为难的困局——其固定尺寸的循环隐状态既要支撑当下的实时计算，又要艰难背负不断累积的历史信息。本文正是要直面并挑战这一长期存在的固有观念：循环状态本身的物理存储容量，并不必然等同于模型长上下文能力的天花板。
> Linear attention models offer the efficiency required for long-context language modeling, but traditionally struggle because their fixed-size recurrent states must simultaneously handle ongoing computation and retain an ever-growing history. This paper challenges the assumption that the recurrent state's memory capacity dictates a model's long-context limit.
作者团队为此提出了 **NoteBank**——一种创新的稀疏情境记忆架构。它在未来提问尚不可知的前提下，前瞻性地甄选并归档重要文本；同时直接调用主干网络的原生特征进行写入与索引寻址，并在需要时通过“重放”机制将检索到的证据无缝融入标准前向计算进行读取。这种免训练、即插即用的轻量方案彻底摆脱了对外部嵌入模型、独立训练检索器或专用神经阅读器的依赖。在高达 100 万 Token 的超长上下文评测中，NoteBank 展现出惊人的威力：它将 Gated DeltaNet 在六项 RULER 检索任务上的平均准确率从近乎不可用的 1.7% 奇迹般提升至 70.3%，且在测试全流程中未见明显性能衰退。更令人瞩目的是，该方法仅引入了极小的理论计算开销 (理论分析浮点运算量 FLOPs 增幅 $\leqslant$0.025%) ，其上下文存储占用也仅为传统 Transformer 的一小部分。跨越多种主干网络——包括三款 1.3B 循环模型、Mamba-2-8B 以及 Qwen3.5-9B——的广泛实验表明，NoteBank 在 LongBench v1/v2 与 MemoryAgentBench 基准上均带来了持续且稳健的性能跃升。
> The authors introduce **NoteBank**, a sparse episodic memory framework that archives selected text before future queries are known, leverages the backbone's native features for writing and addressing, and retrieves evidence through standard forward computation via replay. This training-free, plug-and-play approach requires no external embedding models, separate retrievers, or dedicated neural readers. At one million tokens, NoteBank dramatically increases Gated DeltaNet's mean accuracy across six RULER retrieval tasks from 1.7% to 70.3% without notable degradation. Furthermore, it adds minimal overhead ($\leqslant$0.025% to analytical FLOPs) while utilizing a fraction of the context storage required by traditional Transformers. Experiments span multiple backbones—including 1.3B recurrent models, Mamba-2-8B, and Qwen3.5-9B—demonstrating consistent performance gains on LongBench v1/v2 and MemoryAgentBench.
---
## 论文摘要
> ## Abstract
线性注意力展现了长上下文语言建模梦寐以求的高效潜力，但其固定尺寸的循环隐状态却背负着双重重压：既要维系眼下源源不断的实时计算，又要持久封存无限延展的历史信息。这种计算与记忆的深度纠缠，催生并强化了一种学界的主流认知——即隐状态本身的存储容量上限，直接决定了模型长上下文能力的边界。
> Linear attention promises the efficiency needed for long-context language modelling, yet its fixed-size recurrent state must simultaneously support ongoing computation and preserve information from an ever-growing history. This coupling has reinforced a prevailing view that the state's memory capacity defines the model's long-context capability.
我们明确对这一假想的天花板提出挑战：*循环计算本就不必孤身背负长期存储的全部重担*。为此，我们提出了 **NoteBank**——一种创新的稀疏情境记忆机制。它在未来的提问尚不可知之时，即预先筛选并留存核心文本片段；完全复用主干网络的原生表征完成信息的写入与寻址；并通过“重放”机制将检索到的证据无缝注入原生前向计算中进行阅读。这一 *免训练、即插即用 (Training-Free, Plug-and-Play)* 的接口无需任何额外的外部嵌入模型、专门训练的检索模块或独立的神经阅读器。
> We challenge this presumed ceiling: *recurrent computation need not bear the full burden of long-term storage*. We introduce **NoteBank**, a sparse episodic memory that archives selected text before future queries are known, uses the backbone's native features for writing and addressing, and reads retrieved evidence through its native forward computation via replay. This *training-free, plug-and-play* interface requires no external embedding model, separately trained retriever, or separate neural reader.
在长达 100 万 Token 的超长上下文规模下，NoteBank 将 Gated DeltaNet 在六项 RULER 检索任务上的平均准确率从濒临失效的 1.7% 激增至 70.3%，且从 4K 到 1M Token 跨度内未见任何显著的检索性能退化。这种能力的强势挽回仅带来了微不足道的计算代价 (理论分析浮点运算量 FLOPs 增幅 $\leqslant$0.025%) ，在相同的模型宽度、深度与数值精度下，其持久化上下文存储体积仅为标准 Transformer 完整多头注意力键值缓存 (Full MHA KV Cache) 的约 1/2,600。我们的评测体系涵盖了从三款 1.3B 循环主干到 Mamba-2-8B 以及后训练版 Qwen3.5-9B 的丰富模型阵列，在 LongBench v1/v2 与 MemoryAgentBench 基准上均取得了持续一致的性能提升。综合各项成果，本文有力证明：稀疏证据存储与原生重放机制能够在完美保留循环计算极致效率的同时，大幅解锁预训练线性注意力模型的百万级长上下文潜能。
> At one million tokens, it raises Gated DeltaNet's mean accuracy across six RULER retrieval tasks from 1.7% to 70.3%, with no observed significant retrieval degradation from 4K to 1M tokens. This recovery adds $\leqslant$0.025% to analytical FLOPs, with persistent context storage approximately 1/2,600 that of a Transformer's full MHA KV cache at matched width, depth, and precision. Experiments extend from three 1.3B recurrent backbones to Mamba-2-8B and post-trained Qwen3.5-9B, demonstrating gains on LongBench v1/v2 and MemoryAgentBench. Together, these results show that sparse evidence storage and native replay can substantially expand the long-context capability of pretrained linear attention models while retaining the efficiency of recurrent computation.
---

item.title: SpecFit 破局 MoE 离线推理：草稿 Token 成本差异化与子模优化加速
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-15/SpecFit-破局-MoE-离线推理-草稿-Token-成本差异化与子模优化加速/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-15/SpecFit-破局-MoE-离线推理-草稿-Token-成本差异化与子模优化加速/
item.description:
混合专家模型 (Mixture-of-Experts, MoE) 凭借“按需激活”的稀疏计算特性，在大模型时代实现了参数规模与计算能效的绝佳平衡；然而，当数百亿的专家参数因显存不足而被卸载 (Offload) 到系统主机内存时，从主机内存到显存 (Host-to-Device, H2D) 的跨设备数据传输便瞬间跃升为拖慢自回归解码的核心瓶颈。虽然业界广泛采用投机解码 (Speculative Decoding) 试图通过单次前向传播同时验证多个草稿 Token (Draft Tokens) 来提速，但在 MoE 架构下，每个待验证的候选 Token 都可能唤醒完全不同的专家网络，盲目扩大草稿树不仅无法提速，反倒会迫使系统搬运海量专家权重，出现投机解码速度甚至反常落后于标准自回归解码的“加速负收益”怪象。为了破解这一困局，来自北京航空航天大学等机构的研究团队提出了 **SpecFit** 框架，首次打破了传统投机解码盲目堆砌候选接受长度的单一指标，开创性地确立了“以最大化预测吞吐量为核心”的草稿树动态剪裁准则。SpecFit 精准捕捉到各层激活专家集合并集天然具备的单调子模覆盖 (Monotone Submodular Coverage) 特性，仅针对每个候选节点带来的边际新增专家进行成本核算，并通过祖先闭包子树上的精确搜索算法，在每一个草稿层级动态决策最佳候选组合与最优终止时机。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 等前沿开源模型上的评测表明，SpecFit 在相同专家缓存下相比主流方案 EAGLE-3 实现了最高 21.6% 的解码加速，面对原生 EAGLE-3 更是达成了最高 1.97 倍的强劲吞吐跃迁，为低显存环境下超大规模 MoE 模型的高效落地开辟了全新的工程优化范式。
---
## 内容概要
> ## Summary
在混合专家模型 (MoE) 中，网络每处理一个 Token 仅需激活所有专家中的一小部分子集。然而，当显存容量告急、不得不将庞大的专家层权重参数卸载 (Offload) 到系统主机内存时，在每次解码迭代中将专家数据从主机搬运至 GPU 显存 (H2D) 的传输开销，便无可避免地成为了卡住整个解码流程的关键瓶颈。
> Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models activate only a subset of experts per token. However, when expert weights are offloaded to host memory, host-to-device (H2D) expert transfers become a critical bottleneck during decoding.
投机解码虽然可以通过单次前向验证同时确认多个草稿 Token 来实现推理加速，但它也给 MoE 架构带来了前所未有的特有难题：每一个待验证的候选 Token 都可能激活一组全然不同的专家网络。这导致草稿树分支越多、规模越大，就越会强迫系统从主机内存中搬运海量的专家权重。在如此巨大的显存通信开销拖累下，传统投机解码在 MoE 卸载环境下非但没有提速，实际性能有时甚至比规规矩矩逐字生成的标准自回归解码还要*更差*。
> While speculative decoding accelerates inference by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass, it introduces a unique challenge in MoE models: each verified token activates its own distinct set of experts. Consequently, larger draft trees force massive H2D transfers. Due to this high memory transfer overhead, traditional speculative decoding can sometimes perform *worse* than standard autoregressive decoding.
为了攻克这一痛点，论文作者提出了 **SpecFit** 优化框架。该框架一改传统算法单纯追求最大化接受长度的局限，转为以“最大化预测吞吐量”为核心准则来指导草稿树的构建与裁决：
> To address this issue, the authors introduce **SpecFit**, an optimized framework designed to maximize predicted throughput rather than simply maximizing acceptance length:
* **吞吐量驱动的路径选择 (Throughput-Driven Selection) ：** SpecFit 依据草稿路径的转移概率来精确估算最终被确认的 Token 期望数量，同时综合草稿树的节点规模与各网络层激活专家的并集，精准预测整个验证周期的实际执行耗时。 * **子模优化算法 (Submodular Optimization) ：** 鉴于每一层激活专家的并集在数学上天然构成单调子模覆盖函数 (Monotone Submodular Coverage Function) ，系统在评估每一个新增节点时，能够严格且仅为其引入的“边际新增专家”核算传输开销，避免重复计费。 * **精确子树搜索 (Exact Subtree Search) ：** 通过在满足祖先闭包 (Ancestor-Closed) 约束的候选子树空间中执行精确搜索算法，SpecFit 能够高效锁定能带来最高预测吞吐量的最优子树，并在草稿生成的每个层级动态决断最佳终止时机。
> * **Throughput-Driven Selection:** SpecFit estimates the expected number of committed tokens using draft path probabilities while predicting cycle time based on node count and the per-layer union of activated experts. > * **Submodular Optimization:** Because the per-layer union of experts forms a monotone submodular coverage function, each node is evaluated strictly on the marginal experts it adds. > * **Exact Subtree Search:** An exact search algorithm over ancestor-closed subtrees determines the optimal subtree for the highest predicted throughput and dynamically decides when to stop drafting.

item.title: 防御蒸馏黑魔法：无监督发现与消除大语言模型中的潜意识学习特征
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-13/防御蒸馏黑魔法-无监督发现与消除大语言模型中的潜意识学习特征/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-13/防御蒸馏黑魔法-无监督发现与消除大语言模型中的潜意识学习特征/
item.description: 在当今的人工智能领域，知识蒸馏 (Knowledge Distillation) 是将庞大教师模型的智慧浓缩迁移至轻量化学生模型的常用手段，但这一过程却暗藏着意料之外的风险。最新研究揭示了一种被称为“潜意识学习” (Subliminal Learning) 的隐蔽现象——即使训练数据在语义上完全人畜无害，学生大语言模型 (Large Language Model, LLM) 仍会在无形之中悄然继承教师模型的特定行为偏好，甚至是潜在的未对齐 (Misalignment) 与恶意特征。以往针对这种“数字潜意识”的防御机制，几乎全部依赖于预先知晓具体的危险特征标签，一旦面对未知或隐蔽的特征污染便束手无策。本文团队提出了一种颠覆性的无监督防御机制：通过敏锐捕捉“特定特征跨数据集恒定表达，而常规任务能力因任务而异”的关键不对称性，仅凭参数更新轨迹即可精准定位被传递的隐秘特征。该方案不仅能将特征方向在权重空间中放大以供解释分析，更能将其无损投影剔除以抑制异常行为，在几乎不损害模型核心性能的同时，为大语言模型的安全蒸馏筑牢了“大脑防火墙”。 --- ## 执行摘要 > ## Executive Summary 本文提出了一种针对**潜意识学习** (Subliminal Learning) 的无监督防御机制。所谓潜意识学习，是指在知识蒸馏过程中，即便用于训练的数据在语义层面上与特定特征毫无关联，学生大语言模型也会在无意识中继承教师模型的行为特征 (例如对齐失效或潜在恶意倾向) 。与以往必须预先知晓并依赖显式特征标签的防御方案不同，这项新技术完全从模型的参数更新中分离并还原出被隐秘传递的特征；它巧妙利用了一个核心的不对称性规律：**特定特征在教师模型生成的不同数据集上均表现出高度一致性，而标准任务能力则会随着具体任务的不同而产生差异。** 由此构建的估计器能够精准锁定权重空间中的对应方向——这些方向既可以通过放大来洞察和解释特征背后的行为机制，也可以通过正交投影直接予以剔除，从而在对模型整体任务性能几乎零影响的前提下有效抑制不良行为。 > This paper introduces an unsupervised defense mechanism against **subliminal learning**—a phenomenon where distilled language models unconsciously inherit behavioral traits (such as misalignment) from a teacher model, even when trained on semantically unrelated data. Unlike previous methods requiring explicit trait labels, this new approach isolates and recovers transmitted traits entirely from parameter updates by leveraging a key asymmetry: **traits are expressed consistently across diverse datasets, whereas standard task capabilities vary.** The resulting estimator isolates weight-space directions that can either be amplified for interpretation or projected out to suppress unwanted behaviors with minimal impact on overall task performance. --- ## 论文元数据与详细信息 > ## Metadata & Article Details | 字段 | 详情 | | :--- | :--- | | **arXiv 编号** | [`arXiv:2610.13536`](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13536) [stat.ML] | | **学科领域** | 机器学习 (`stat.ML`)；人工智能 (`cs.AI`)；机器学习 (`cs.LG`) | | **提交日期** | 2026年10月9日 | | **作者** | Joseph Egan, Ciarán M. Gilligan-Lee, Michael O'Riordan, Yuchen Zhu | | **许可协议** | [知识共享署名 4.0 国际许可协议 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0)](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | > | Field | Detail | > | :--- | :--- | > | **arXiv ID** | [`arXiv:2610.13536`](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13536) [stat.ML] | > | **Subjects** | Machine Learning (`stat.ML`); Artificial Intelligence (`cs.AI`); Machine Learning (`cs.LG`) | > | **Submission Date** | October 9, 2026 | > | **Authors** | Joseph Egan, Ciarán M. Gilligan-Lee, Michael O'Riordan, Yuchen Zhu | > | **License** | [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | --- ## 论文摘要 > ## Abstract 当基于相同底座参数对大语言模型进行知识蒸馏时，即便训练数据在语义上与特定特征毫无关联，学生模型依然能够“潜意识”般继承教师模型的特定行为特征，甚至包括潜在的对齐失效风险 (Cloud et al., 2026) 。然而，目前所有现存的防御手段都存在一个致命前提——必须预先知晓具体的特征是什么。 > When a language model is distilled from a teacher that shares its base parameters, the student can inherit behavioural traits of the teacher—including misalignment—even from data that is semantically unrelated to the trait (Cloud et al., 2026). All existing defences require knowing the trait. 本文彻底打破了这一限制，并从理论与实验上证明：无需任何人工监督，仅凭参数更新本身就能完全还原出潜意识传递的特征。这一突破归功于作者团队敏锐捕捉到的一个关键不对称性：由教师模型生成的不同数据集之间，特定隐蔽特征的表达始终保持高度一致；相反，针对具体任务的专用能力以及通用共享能力则在不同数据分布间呈现出显著差异。 > We remove this requirement and prove that a subliminally transferred trait can be recovered from the parameter updates alone, without supervision, by exploiting a single asymmetry: the trait is expressed consistently across diverse datasets generated by the teacher, whereas task-specific and shared capabilities vary. 基于该原理构建的估计器能够精准求解出权重空间中的特征方向：研究人员既可以通过放大该方向的权重分量来直观探测并解释该特征的运作机理，也可以通过正交投影直接将其剔除，从而彻底压制异常行为的表达。在 (Cloud et al., 2026) 提出的潜意识学习基准测试中，该方法在完全不需要任何特征标签的情况下，成功还原出了被隐秘传递的动物偏好特征，并在对模型核心任务性能几乎毫无影响的前提下彻底消除了其行为表现。 > The resulting estimator returns a weight-space direction that can be amplified to discover and interpret the trait or projected out to suppress it. Applied to the subliminal-learning benchmarks of (Cloud et al., 2026), our method recovers the transmitted animal-preference traits without any trait labels and suppresses their expression with almost no impact to task performance. --- ## 论文获取与相关资源 > ## Access & Resources * **全文获取途径：** [查看 PDF 原文](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.13536) | [实验性 HTML](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13536v1) | [TeX 源码](https://arxiv.org/src/2610.13536) * **引文与学术指标：** [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?arxiv_id=2610.13536) | [Semantic Scholar](https://api.semanticscholar.org/arXiv:2610.13536) | [NASA ADS](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/arXiv:2610.13536) * **项目工具与社区生态：** [alphaXiv](https://alphaxiv.org/) | [CatalyzeX Code Finder](https://www.catalyzex.com) | [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/huggingface) > * **Full-Text Options:** [View PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.13536) | [Experimental HTML](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13536v1) | [TeX Source](https://arxiv.org/src/2610.13536) > * **Citations & Metrics:** [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?arxiv_id=2610.13536) | [Semantic Scholar](https://api.semanticscholar.org/arXiv:2610.13536) | [NASA ADS](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/arXiv:2610.13536) > * **Project Tools & Ecosystem:** [alphaXiv](https://alphaxiv.org/) | [CatalyzeX Code Finder](https://www.catalyzex.com) | [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/huggingface)

item.title: 从准同步到同步：数字电话通信网络的世纪演进历程
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-13/从准同步到同步-数字电话通信网络的演进历程/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-13/从准同步到同步-数字电话通信网络的演进历程/
item.description: 本文系统梳理了现代通信网络从模拟时代走向全同步数字网络的百年演进之路。文章深入剖析了模拟信号的固有衰减痛点如何倒逼二战密码通信技术催生出脉冲编码调制 (Pulse Code Modulation, PCM) 与 T 载波 (T-carrier) 革命；详细复盘了准同步数字体系 (Plesiochronous Digital Hierarchy, PDH) 在各自分立的独立时钟下，如何利用“比特填充 (bit stuffing) ”与“借位信令 (robbed-bit signaling) ”等精妙而别扭的工程妥协维持运转；最后深度阐释了光纤革命与巨头拆分如何催生出光同步数字网络 (Synchronous Optical Network, SONET) 与同步数字体系 (Synchronous Digital Hierarchy, SDH) ，凭借微秒级的全局统一授时、自愈环网架构以及灵活的分插复用 (Add-Drop Multiplexing, ADM) ，彻底重塑了现代全球通信底座。 --- ## 内容摘要 > ## Summary 本文追溯了电信技术从模拟系统演进到当今完全同步数字网络的历史轨迹。文章探讨了模拟信号的物理局限性如何推动了数字脉冲编码调制 (Pulse Code Modulation, PCM) 的普及——这一进程始于二战时期的保密语音通信系统 (SIGSALY) ，最终在 1962 年 AT&T 推出 T 载波 (T-carrier) 系统时达到高潮。 > This article traces the evolution of telecommunications from analog systems to the fully synchronized digital networks of the modern era. It explores how the limitations of analog signals drove the adoption of digital pulse code modulation (PCM), beginning with WWII-era cryptography (SIGSALY) and culminating in AT&T's introduction of the T-carrier in 1962. 文章详细剖析了**准同步数字体系 (Plesiochronous Digital Hierarchy, PDH) **充满妥协与“野蛮生长”的发展历程——着重介绍了为了向下兼容而不得不引入的“比特填充 (bit-stuffing) ”与“借位信令 (robbed-bit signaling) ”等特异机制，并阐明了在相互独立的异构网络间进行时钟对齐、复用以及提取单路信道所面临的巨大挑战。最后，文章探讨了光纤技术的兴起、AT&T 的反垄断拆分以及全球标准化互通的需求，如何共同孕育了**光同步数字网络 (Synchronous Optical Network, SONET) **与同步数字体系 (Synchronous Digital Hierarchy, SDH) ，并最终通过高精度授时、自愈环网拓扑以及分插复用技术，彻底取代了昔日粗糙的“大致同步”。 > The piece details the messy, organic growth of the **Plesiochronous Digital Hierarchy (PDH)**—highlighting quirks like bit-stuffing and robbed-bit signaling required for backwards compatibility—and explains the immense challenges of timing, multiplexing, and extracting individual channels across independent networks. Finally, it examines how the arrival of fiber optics, the breakup of AT&T, and the need for standardized global interoperability gave rise to **SONET (Synchronous Optical Network)** and SDH, ultimately replacing "approximate synchronicity" with precise time-keeping, ring architectures, and add-drop multiplexing. --- ## 数字体系的演进 > ## The Digital Hierarchy 在 20 世纪 60 年代以前，电话通话一直是以模拟信号的形式进行传输的。当时网络中大量采用了频分复用 (Frequency Division Multiplexing, FDM) 技术，将信号加载到[架空明线](https://computer.rip/2021-12-05-singing-wires.html)以及部分[同轴电缆](https://computer.rip/2021-12-13-coaxial-goes-to-war.html)上传输，而在二战后的时期，地下埋设的多对双绞线电缆开始占据统治地位。尽管当时的电话网络功能表现出奇地好——即便是跨越美国东西两岸的长途通话依然相当清晰——但模拟载波存在着无法逾越的物理限制。通话质量在传输链路的每一次中继与放大中都会发生衰减；而对于那些敏感的数据传输连接而言，这种衰减问题显得尤为致命，而数字通信显然正是电话系统的未来方向。当时所谓的“数字通信”，仅仅是将数字信号调制在电话线路*顶层*：电话系统本身依然将它们视作普通的模拟通话，只是需要对其传输质量予以特殊关照。 > Up until the 1960s, telephone calls were carried as analog signals. There was a great deal of frequency division multiplexing onto [open wire](https://computer.rip/2021-12-05-singing-wires.html), and sometimes [coaxial cables](https://computer.rip/2021-12-13-coaxial-goes-to-war.html), but in the post-war period buried multipair telephone cables began to dominate. While the network was surprisingly functional—long distance calls from coast to coast were still quite intelligible—there were fundamental limitations to analog carriers. The quality of the call would degrade with each step, a problem that was much more acute for the sensitive digital connections that were already the apparent future of the telephone system. These were digital signals modulated *over the top* of telephone lines: the telephone system itself still handled them as analog calls, just ones that required special care for quality. 在第二次世界大战期间，人们逐渐意识到，如果能以数字信号作为整套长途通信系统的底层架构，长途网络面临的诸多棘手难题就能迎刃而解。1943 年，Bell Labs 参与设计了一款名为 SIGSALY 的早期加密语音通信系统。与二战初期使用的“语音扰频器”及其他模拟手段不同，SIGSALY 的工作原理与现代数字加密技术惊人地相似。它将语音数据量化为数值，从而可以使用数字算术逻辑对其进行编码加密。在为语音打造密码系统的探索过程中，Bell Labs 顺带构建了人类首个用于 PCM 数字语音传输的实用系统。战后，对该技术进行改良并推广至常规民用通信服务，自然成为了水到渠成的一步。 > During the Second World War, it became apparent that many of the long distance network's challenges could be greatly simplified by using digital signaling as the basis of the entire long distance system. In 1943, Bell Labs contributed to the design of an early encrypted voice communications system called SIGSALY. Unlike the "voice scramblers" and other analog techniques of the early phase of the war, SIGSALY was recognizably similar to modern encryption. The voice data was quantized into numerical values, so that digital arithmetic could be used to encode it. In the quest to build a cryptosystem for voice, Bell Labs incidentally built the first applied system for PCM digital voice transmission. After the war, it was an obvious next step to refine this technology and apply it to regular service. 但这并不意味着电话网络立刻就普及了端到端的纯数字服务，至少起初并非如此：事实上绝大多数用户本地回路 (subscriber loops) 直至今日依然是模拟线路。在数字网络起步的最初几年里，甚至电话局自身的交换机处理的也全都是纯模拟信号。然而在局间中继线上，将模拟信道编码为数字信号彻底解决了诸多痛点，从语音质量劣化、微波链路过载，到流量路由调度的灵活性问题无一不迎刃而解。数字化演进成为了 AT&T 所谓*载波 (carrier) *概念的核心组成部分，正如 20 世纪 20 年代频分复用技术的地位一样。这正是 1962 年商用电话系统中首个数字载波体系——[T 载波 (T-carrier)](https://computer.rip/2025-09-20-T-carrier.html)问世的历史背景。 > This didn't necessarily mean direct digital service, at least not at first: most subscriber loops remain analog to the present day. For the first years of the digital network, even the exchanges themselves switched purely analog signals. Between offices, though, encoding the analog channels into digital ones solved problems from audio quality, to microwave path overloading, to flexibility in traffic routing. Digitization became a core part of AT&T's concept of a *carrier,* just like frequency division multiplexing had in the 1920s. That's the background to the 1962 introduction of [T-carrier](https://computer.rip/2025-09-20-T-carrier.html), the first digital carrier in the commercial telephone system. 在上一篇关于 T 载波的文章中 (如果你对这个话题感兴趣，强烈推荐阅读！) ，我曾解释过 T1、T2、T3 等是指带宽呈层级递增的物理连接，它们分别负责承载 DS1、DS2、DS3 等不同级别的数字信号 (Digital Signal, DS) 。让我们快速回顾一下这个分层体系概念，顺便再引入一个颇具迷惑性的硬件概念——D1 信道机 (channel bank) 。D1 信道机是一种实体硬件设备，它负责将 24 路模拟语音信道进行数字化采样，并将它们复用成一路 DS1 信号，最终在 T1 载波线路上传输。 > Back in the article on T-carrier (which you should read if you are at all interested in this topic!), I explained that T1, T2, T3, etc. are hierarchically larger-bandwidth connections that carry the DS1, DS2, DS3, etc. digital signals respectively. Let's quickly review this hierarchical concept and, just to keep things interesting, add the further confusion of the D1 channel bank. A D1 channel bank is the physical piece of equipment that digitizes 24 voice channels and multiplexes them into a DS1 signal, which will be carried over T1 carrier. 以此类推，4 路 DS1 信号可以复用成 1 路 DS2 信号并在 T2 线路上传输；7 路 DS2 信号可以汇聚成 1 路 DS3 信号并在 T3 线路上传输。依此类推，一直延伸到当时技术所能达到的极限。DS2 级别通常大致对应 D2 信道机，但这种对应关系很容易让人混淆，因为后来研发的信道机不仅扩大了容量，还增添了诸多全新功能。D2 信道机能够将 96 路通话复用到一路 DS2 信号中，但它同时还提升了音频信道的整体质量，以满足通用混合长途业务的技术指标 (最初 D1 信道机仅获批用于常规语音通话，无法满足数据级专线等严苛应用的需求) 。 > Similarly, four DS1 signals can be combined into a DS2 signal and carried over T2. Seven DS2 signals can be combined into a single DS3 signal and carried over T3. And so on, at least as far as they were able to get with the technology of the time. The DS2 level maps generally to the D2 channel bank, but that relationship can be confusing as the subsequently developed channel banks added features as well as capacity. The D2 channel bank could multiplex 96 channels onto a DS2 signal, but it also increased the overall quality of the audio channel to meet the technical requirements for general mixed toll service (the D1 had originally only been approved for conventional voice channels, not other applications like data-grade leased lines). 为了实现这一音质飞跃，D2 必须降低混入信号中的量化噪声。早期的 D1 信道机采用的是每个采样点 7 比特的 PCM 音频，而工程理论计算表明，达到长途级通话质量至少需要每个采样点 8 比特 [^1]。从表面上看，这似乎很容易实现：因为 DS1 体系本来就采用了 8 比特的单元。然而，那未被纳入 PCM 音频采样的第 8 个比特，此前一直被预留用于系统信令交互。不过这倒难不倒工程师：由于 D1 信道机原本就用不满全部信令带宽，因此完全可以削减信令速率来达成折中方案。于是，D2 信道机在大多数采样点上采用了满格的 8 比特，但每隔 6 个帧，每个采样的最后 1 个比特就会被“借走”，用于传输信令而非音频。这种做法虽然使量化噪声略有上升，并大幅削减了信令速率，但两者的最终指标都完美落在了工程允许的容差范围内。这是一个绝妙的妥协方案，但在技术美学上却显得极为别扭：从数学意义上看，D2 信道机相当于在每个样本中使用了 7.833 个比特。这确实够让人头皮发麻的。 > In order to make that improvement, the D2 had to reduce the amount of quantization noise introduced into the signal. The D1 channel bank had used PCM audio with seven bits per sample, and calculations showed that eight bits per sample would be required for a toll-grade connection [^1]. In a way, that looked easy: DS1 already used 8-bit units. But the eighth bit, not used as part of the PCM sample, was reserved for signaling purposes. No bother: the D1 channel bank hadn't really used the full signaling bandwidth anyway, so it could comfortably be reduced to meet a compromise position. The D2 channel bank used 8 bits for most PCM samples, but every six frames the last bit of each sample was reserved for signaling use rather than audio. This created a slight increase in quantization noise, and a significant decrease in signaling rate, but the resulting numbers for both fell within acceptable margins. A perfect compromise, but one that feels technically inelegant: in a sense, the D2 channel bank used 7.833 bits per sample. Ouch. 这种工程“打补丁”式的设计当年想必也让 Bell System 的工程师们感到浑身难受，但为了向下兼容，牺牲这点设计美感完全是值得的。当 D2 信道机于 1970 年正式投入商用时，网络中已经铺设了海量的 D1 信道机和 T1 线路。向下兼容现有 T1 线路成为了不可动摇的硬性指标。D2 复用了 96 路信道，容量是 D1 的 4 倍，并且可以通过 4 条 T1 链路来承载这 96 路信道——事实上在最初阶段，这也是唯一的部署选项。因为 T2 及其后续更高级别的载波系统直到 D2 投产之后才真正问世。正是这种向下兼容性，不仅为老设备提供了平滑升级路径，还提供了一种将 96 路大容量拆分分流的手段。 > This must have given the Bell System's engineers similar discomfort, but the aesthetic offense was worth it for backwards-compatibility. By the time the D2 channel bank was fielded in 1970, there were a huge number of D1 channel banks and T1 connections in service. Backwards-compatibility to existing T1 lines was a firm requirement. The D2 multiplexed 96 channels, four times a D1, and could carry those channels over four T1 links—in fact, initially, this was only the option. T2 and subsequent carriers were not fielded until after the D2. This backwards compatibility provided an upgrade path, as well as a way to subdivide the 96-channel capacity. 你或许已经意识到，这也为我们理解“分层体系”提供了一种截然不同的视角。 > You might realize that it is also a completely alternate explanation of the "hierarchy." 你可能会纳闷，为什么这个分层体系中每一层级的复用倍数会如此杂乱无章——24、4、7、6 各不相同？读到上文中每 6 个样本抽取信令比特的设计，或许会唤醒你对“借位信令 (robbed-bit signaling) ”这一概念的深刻记忆——这是一种在 T1 系统中广泛采用的做法，即偶尔“偷窃”几个比特挪作他用。这些都是系统底层设计上的“坏味道”，表明这套体系根本不是预先*精心架构*出来的，而是如同野草一般*野蛮生长*出来的。由 T1、T2、T3 等构成的“数字体系”，绝非什么优雅纯粹的设计，至少远没有 T4 时代《Bell Laboratories Record》期刊吹捧得那么天衣无缝。正如 Dn 系列信道机的发展史所揭示的那样，这主要是历史偶然与现实妥协的产物：每一代全新的信道机 (如 D3、D4) 都被要求承载远多于前代的信道数量，同时还必须死死保证与老款信道机和旧载波线路的向下兼容。正是这种在背负沉重历史包袱下的指数级扩容演进，最终顺理成章地催生出了这套数字体系，它纯粹是现实妥协结出的自然果实，而非蓝图规划的既定杰作。 > You might wonder why the multipliers at the levels of the hierarchy are so inconsistent—24, 4, 7, 6. Reading the thing about signaling bits in every six samples above might have stirred deep memories of a concept called "robbed-bit signaling," a general concept of stealing occasional bits for other purposes that was widely used with T1. These are all smells, indications that a system was not *architected*, but *grown*. The "digital hierarchy" of T1, T2, T3, etc. is not some elegantly-designed system, at least not nearly as much as T4-era Bell Laboratories Record articles like to make it sound. It's mostly a result of happenstance, as the history of the Dn channel banks shows: each new channel bank, the D3, the D4, was designed to carry many more channels than those before. They were also required to be backwards-compatible with the use of the older channel banks and carriers. This process of exponential improvement with backwards compatibility led to the digital hierarchy as a natural consequence, not as a designed outcome. --- ## 准同步性：戴着镣铐起舞的时钟对齐之术 > ## Plesiochronicity 这种不断涌现的、由更大多路复用器 (multiplexer, mux) 逐层堆叠的概念解释了数字体系的由来，但现在我们必须面对一个核心难题：定时 (timing) 与同步 (synchronization) 。 > This emergent concept of layers of successively larger muxes explains the digital hierarchy, but we now need to consider the problem of timing and synchronization. 在任何基于数字采样的系统中，若想将多路信号合并在一起，你必须精准掌握每个采样点的采集时间。设想这样一个场景：几通并发的电话需要被合并进同一个数字复用流中进行传输。当电话信号到达 D1 (或 D2、D3 等) 信道机时，信道机会在适当时刻对所有输入信号进行采样，从而构建出 DS1 (或更高级别) 的输出数据流。这种情况本身并没有什么特别复杂的，唯独有一个刚性要求：汇入该数字流的所有通话采样，必须全部受控于同一个时钟源。 > In any system based on digital sampling, you have to be aware at the point at which those samples are taken in order to combine multiple signals. Consider the scenario where several simultaneous phone calls are being combined into a single digital mux for transmission. When the phone calls reach a D1 (or D2, D3, etc) channel bank, it samples all of the inputs at an appropriate time to build its DS1 (or higher) output stream. Nothing about this case is particularly complicated, except that it does require that all of the calls involved in the digital stream are sampled under the control of the same clock. 但是，如果各路电话线路必须在不同的地理位置分别进行数字化，情况又会如何呢？假设某座城市里有两座较小的端局 (local offices) ，需要将局间通话流量输送给邻近城市的中继汇接局 (tandem switch) 。一种显而易见的方法是：在各自的端局先将通话数字化，然后作为数字信号传输到其中一座端局 (比如市中心的枢纽局) ，再将所有这些数字信号合并在一起发往汇接局。但在当年，用现成的信道机来做这件事是非常糟糕的：你实际上必须先把这些通话重新解码变回模拟信号，然后再重新编码采样变回数字信号，才能将它们从第一段数字链路中继到第二段数字链路。最早期的数字电话线路就是这种形态：完全是点对点的，根本无法在纯数字层面进行交换或路由。在早期所有交换机本身都是模拟设备、数字链路仅仅用于提高局间线路利用率时，这还不算什么大问题；但它却彻底阻碍了 Bell Labs 构想的纯全数字网络的建设。 > But what about cases where lines need to be digitized in different locations? Say you have two smaller offices in a city, that need to deliver inter-office traffic to a tandem in the next city over. An obvious approach would be to digitize the calls in each of their local offices, send them as digital signals to one of the offices (perhaps the city's main downtown exchange), and then combine all of those digital signals together to be sent to the tandem switch. Doing this with channel banks wasn't very desirable: you would actually need to convert the calls back to analog, and then back to digital, in order to relay them from the first digital leg to the second. The first digital telephone leads were like this: completely point-to-point, without the possibility of switching or routing in the digital realm. That wasn't so big of a limitation early on when all of the switches were analog and digital leads just made the lines between them denser, but it prevented the construction of the fully digital network that Bell Labs envisioned. 行业显然急需一种新型复用器：它可以直接接收已经成型的 4 路 DS1 信号，并将它们直接合并为 1 路 DS2 信号。如果更高级别也能照此办理，就能搭建起一套根据各端局流量需求灵活汇聚和分流业务的基础体系。但如此一来，各路采样的时钟定时问题该如何解决呢？ > What was clearly needed was some sort of mux that could take four DS1s, already in that form, and combine them into a DS2. Repeat this for the higher levels as well, and you have the basis of a system that can combine and separate traffic as needed to meet the level of demand between various offices. But what about the sample timing? 在 20 世纪 70 年代，如果你手头有来自 4 个不同物理地点的 DS1 数据流，它们之间是绝不可能天然同步的。这 4 台 D1 信道机各自运行在自己的独立采样时钟上；由于现实物理世界晶振器件的不完美，这些时钟彼此间不可避免地会出现微小的走快或走慢。当这 4 路 DS1 流抵达预想中的复用器时，它们不仅存在相位偏差 (out of phase) ，而且实际传输速率也存在细微差异。 > If you have four DS1 streams from four different places, at least back in the 1970s, they are not going to be synchronized. The four D1 channel banks would each be operating on their own sample clocks, and because of the imperfection of the physical world some of these clocks would run slightly faster or slower than others. When our four DS1 streams arrived at our notional multiplexer, the four streams would be not only out of phase, they would actually run at slightly different speeds. 从现代工程视角来看，我们能想出许多解决这一难题的方案，最典型的莫过于在内存中开辟较大的缓冲区暂存采样数据块，然后再统一从缓冲区打出。然而在 70 年代，事情远非如此简单：首先，相比于当时的传输比特率，内存昂贵且速度缓慢；其次，此前全模拟网络中的信号传播延迟仅仅受限于光速，而在网络中进行大量缓冲所引入的延迟，在当时的电话网标准下是根本无法接受的。 > We can imagine a lot of modern solutions to this problem, probably by buffering relatively large blocks of samples in memory and then transmitting out of that buffer. In the '70s, things weren't so simple: first, memory was expensive and slow compared to the bitrates involved, and second, the latency involved in such extensive buffering was not considered acceptable in a network that had previously been all-analog and thus had no more latency than that implied by the speed of light. 针对这一时钟同步难题诞生的解决方案——准同步数字体系 (PDH) ，从我们当下的视角来看并不容易被理解。许多网络与通信教材虽然都会提及 PDH，但往往一笔带过、浮于表面，读完总给人一种说不清道不明的别扭感。PDH 之所以让人感到疏离，原因有二：首先，它是为了解决一系列由于更广泛的技术进步而早已不复存在的历史痛点；其次，即便放在当时的约束条件下，它也早已被更先进的技术彻底淘汰。放在今天，绝不会有任何工程师会设计出 PDH 这样的架构。回顾历史，最好将它视为一次工程上的“黑客式临时拼凑 (hack) ”。可以说，PDH 是一项过渡时期的权宜之策，它在数字信道机的诞生与后来真正*成熟优秀*的数字网络同步技术之间架起了一座桥梁。 > The solution to this problem, the Plesiochronous Digital Hierarchy or PDH, is not easy to understand from our contemporary perspective. Many textbooks on networking and communications make some nod to PDH, but it's often short and cursory, and leaves you with a nagging feeling that the whole thing doesn't make much sense. PDH is hard to relate to for two reasons: first, it was developed to solve a set of problems that (due to broader technical advancements) we no longer have. Second, even within those constraints, it is a solution that has been obsoleted by newer approaches. PDH is not something that anyone would design today, and in retrospect, it's probably best to think of it as a hack. PDH was an interim measure, if you will, that bridged a gap between the development of digital channel banks and the later development of a *good* approach to synchronizing a digital network. 如果当年信道机和同步网络能够同步设计，事情自然会理想得多，但在现实中并非如此：在 AT&T 拿出一套合理的数字网络架构之前整整十年，数字长途线路就已经被普遍使用了。你可以看到，早在 20 世纪 60 年代末，他们就已经在思考这些需求，并萌生出了将 PDH 作为分层网络架构的概念；但构建该网络所需的大部分核心*技术*，直到 70 年代和 80 年代才真正被研发出来。在很长一段时间里，通信网里运行的仅仅是“勉强能用”的东西——一个用工程绝缘胶布糊上去的临时补丁，一套概念层面上绑着铁丝网勉力维持的权宜产物。 > It would have been more convenient if those two systems had been designed at the same time, but in practice, they weren't: digital long distance lines were in common use a solid decade before AT&T had a reasonable architecture for a digital network. You can already see that they were thinking through these requirements in the late 1960s, leading to the concept of the PDH as a hierarchical network architecture, but most of the actual *technology* to provide that network was built later, in the '70s and '80s. For a while, there was just, you know, something that worked. A duct tape fix. Conceptual bailing wire. 那么，究竟什么是 PDH？我们不妨先从定义“plesiochronous (准同步) ”这个词开始，每本教科书都绕不开它，因为这个词正是 Bell Labs 为了描述其设计而生造出来的。这里就不考究词根了，但它的含义就是“几乎同步”或“大致同步”。这正是 PDH 的本质：它是一套留有松动余量的同步数字系统，预留了一丁点儿容差游隙。 > So what even was the PDH? It is helpful to start by defining the word "plesiochronous," which every textbook has to do since the term was invented by Bell Labs to describe their design. I will spare the roots, but plesiochronous means "almost synchronized" or "approximately synchronized." And that's what the PDH was: it was a synchronous digital system with some slop. There was a little wiggle room. 一路 DS1 信号的速率是 1.544 Mbps，如果将 4 路 DS1 信号复用在一起，你直觉上可能会认为输出速率是 6.176 Mbps。但你猜错了：一路 DS2 的实际速率是 6.312 Mbps。这里多出来的额外开销，恰恰来自于准同步 (plesiochronous) 里的这个“准 (plesio) ”字。要理解它的工作机制，我们需要从头审视复用器的设计。按照 AT&T 的命名习惯，将 DS1 级别复用到 DS2 级别的设备被称为 M12 (顾名思义，即从 1 到 2 的 Multiplexer) 。而在实际工程部署中，M13 型设备似乎更为普遍，其内部通常实现为 7 台 M12 输出汇入 1 台 M23。 > A DS1 signal is 1.544 Mbps, so if you multiplex four of them, you might expect 6.176 Mbps. You would be wrong: a DS2 is actually 6.312 Mbps. The overhead here comes from the *plesio* part of plesiochronous. To understand how that works, we should look at the design of the multiplexer from the beginning. AT&T practice would call a multiplexer from the DS1 level to the DS2 level an M12, for, well, multiplexer from 1 to 2. In practice M13s seem to have been more common equipment, which were often implemented internally as seven M12s feeding one M23. 无论如何，M12 接收 4 路不同的 DS1 数据流，然后将它们按比特位交织 (bit-interleave) 在一起，使得输出流中的每隔第 4 个比特位依次对应其中一个输入信道的下一个比特。这种机制逻辑清晰，最大的优势在于硬件中几乎完全不需要缓冲。但问题来了：如果其中一个输入流跑得稍快，而另一个输入流跑得稍慢，该怎么办？首先要明确的是，复用器的输出总流速率在设计上被故意调得比所有输入流的速率总和*还要稍快一点*。一套典型的 PDH 系统允许各路输入的速率有 $\pm 50\text{ PPM}$ (百万分之五十) 的波动误差，这意味着输出总速率必须相对于所有输入之和快上至少 50 PPM。通过这种超频设计，复用器就永远不会因为某个输入流喷射比特的速度过快而发生“赶不上、来不及交织”的积压故障。 > In any case, the M12 takes in four different DS1 streams and then bit-interleaves them, such that every 4th bit of the output is the next bit from one of the inputs. This is simple to reason about and has the advantage that virtually no buffering ever happens. But what if one of the inputs is running slightly fast, and another slightly slow? The first thing to know is that the output stream is intentionally slightly faster than *all* of the inputs. A typical PDH system allowed a 50 PPM plus or minus variation in the rate of the inputs, which means that the output had to be at least 50 PPM fast relative to the sum of the inputs. That way, the multiplexer will never "fall behind" because an input is providing bits faster than the output can interleave them. 另一个核心要点是，复用器必须执行一项被称为*填充 (stuffing) *或*码速调整 (justification) *的功能。据说 AT&T 内部引入“justification”这个词是因为它听起来更具学术专业范儿，而一线工程师则更喜欢直截了当的“stuffing (塞比特) ”。每个外发帧的特定位置在标准中被定义为“可填充位”，有时也被称作“间隙 (gaps) ”。在这些位置上，复用器既被允许填入有效数据，也被允许塞入被称为*填充比特 (stuffing bits) * (或者更专业地称为*调整比特 (justification bits) *) 的无意义伪数据。通过决定是在间隙中填入真实数据还是塞入填充比特，复用器实际上能够灵活地上下微调“真实”输出数据速率。如此一来，尽管各路输入的实际速度会因“时钟噪声”而出现微幅忽快忽慢，总输出却能在动态微调中精准收敛到正确的平均值 (即所有输入的实际总和) 。 > The other thing to know is that the multiplexer must perform a function known as either *stuffing* or *justification.* It is said that the term *justification* was introduced within AT&T because it sounded more technical, while *stuffing* was more popular with the actual engineers. Certain parts of each outgoing frame are defined (by standard) as *stuffable,* and they're sometimes called *gaps.* These are sections where the multiplexer is allowed to either include real data, or to include some nonsense data called *stuffing bits* (or, if you want to sound more technical, *justification bits*). By choosing to either include real data or stuffing in the gaps, the multiplexer can actually adjust the "real" output data rate up or down. That way, it converges onto the correct average (the sum of the inputs) despite the "timing noise" of the inputs varying slightly up and down in real speed. 如果你觉得上述解释有些抽象，不妨换个角度来理解：我们可以把 DS2 输出帧想象成由 4 个“卡槽”组成，4 路 DS1 输入帧分别塞入其中 (虽然在微观上它们是按比特逐位交叉交织的，并不那么直观，但在宏观数学逻辑上完全等价) 。在 PDH 设计下，这些卡槽在尺寸上全部被设计得*略宽于*输入帧，从而留出了“充裕空间”，允许输入帧向左向右微移或被适当拉长。这使得复用器既能通过快速吐出追平跑快了的输入，也能通过留白拉伸平抑跑慢了的输入。将这一机制理解为一个可随心所欲放置输入的宽槽，也能让我们更好地领会“justification (两端对齐/码速调整) ”一词的精妙之处：你可以左右挪动比特，或者在它们之间填塞额外空隙，就像排版软件对齐文本一样。 > If that didn't make sense to you, here's a different way to think about the same thing: we can imagine the DS2 output frame as consisting of four "slots" into which the four DS1 input frames are inserted (this isn't quite intuitive because they are interleaved bit-by-bit, but the math works out the same). Under the PDH design, these slots are all *slightly wider* than the input frames, so that there is "free space" for the input frames to be shifted a bit in either direction or stretched out. That allows the multiplexer to "catch up" on a fast input or to "draw out" the frames from a slow input. Thinking about it in terms of a wide slot that you can place the input into as desired also gives more value to the term "justification:" you can shift bits around, or add extra space in between them, just like you would to justify text. 这一构想在工程落地时相当复杂，因为链路另一端的解复用器必须准确知道究竟哪些比特是填充进去的无用位，以便将它们剔除扔掉。正因如此，PDH 在帧结构的固定位置预先规定了间隙：控制信令中包含了一组指示标志 (flags) ，专门用于标明这些固定间隙到底是被填入了真实数据还是填充比特。当复用器根据输入流是否跑在输出前面来决定是否动用可填充位时，它还必须把这个决策暂存到帧末尾，以确保控制标志能够被准确设置。 > The actual implementation of this idea is pretty complicated, because the demultiplexer on the other end needs to know which bits were stuffed so that they can be discarded. That's why PDH specified gaps at fixed positions: the control signaling included a set of flags that indicated whether the fixed gaps were used for data or stuffing. When the multiplexer decided whether or not to use a stuffable bit (based on whether or not the input was getting ahead of the output mux), it also had to store that decision for the end of the frame so that the flag could be set correctly. PDH 称不上是一套优雅的方案，但它确实解决了现实问题；基于 PDH 路线，工程师们一路设计出了高达 DS4 级别的复用器。我们理应向 PDH 致以崇高敬意，正是这个笨重粗糙的权宜之计，支撑起了覆盖全美的早期数字化电话网络。但话虽如此，它的致命缺陷也同样不可小觑。 > PDH wasn't an elegant solution, but it was a solution, and multiplexers were designed up to the DS4 level based on the PDH approach. We all owe PDH a huge thanks for providing the clunky stopgap that allowed the construction of a nationwide digital telephone network. That said, well, it had quite a few downsides. 首先，PDH 在标准化方面一直非常欠缺。今天去考证研究 PDH 相当棘手，因为几乎没有多少文献能详尽记录它在美国本土的实际工程实现，大多只有概要介绍、概念示意图以及来自欧洲的案例。据我所知 [^2]，Western Electric 甚至从未真正推出过一款独立的商用 PDH 复用器。Western Electric 的大型集成系统 (比如微波载波设备机架) 中可能会内置 PDH 复用模块，但我甚至无法确定 Western Electric 本身是否真的生产过它们——我能找到的 PDH 复用器广告和报价单全部来自其他第三方厂商，比如 Farinon 和 NEC。 > First, PDH was never all that well standardized. Researching PDH is tricky because there aren't a lot of documents that provide conclusive detail about the actual implementation in the US, mostly just summaries, conceptual sketches, and examples from Europe. As far as I can tell [^2], Western Electric never really offered a standalone PDH multiplexer. Larger integrated systems from Western Electric (like, say, a microwave carrier equipment bay) might include a PDH multiplexer, but it's not clear to me if WE even made them—the advertisements and pricing information I can find for PDH multiplexers are from other vendors like Farinon and NEC. 在北美的工程实践中，PDH 似乎从未形成过坚固统一的工业标准，不同厂商的设备之间存在着各种实现层面的差异。这大概也是 PDH 设备文献如此匮乏的原因之一：电信局通常不会单独购买一台独立的 PDH 复用器，而是将其作为大型专用系统的一部分来指定特定型号。这意味着 PDH 网络的实际灵活性远远达不到 AT&T 最初的设想。 > In North American practice, it doesn't seem like PDH was ever robustly standardized, and there were implementation differences between equipment from different manufacturers. That's probably one of the reasons for the scarcity of information on PDH equipment: you wouldn't usually buy a single PDH multiplexer, but instead would specify a specific model as part of a larger system. That meant that the PDH network was far less flexible than AT&T had hoped. 如果把视线转向海外，混乱的情况就更严重了：AT&T 的作风往往是先由 Bell Labs 和 Western Electric 把最新成果火速投产，事后再将其强行推举为标准。而欧洲的电信运营商往往要等到美国的技术成熟后才予以跟进，这反而让他们有机会在硬件设备铺设之前从容制定出统一的标准规范。因此，许多通信技术的欧洲版本往往比美国原版设计得更为严谨合理，PDH 也不例外。事实上，美国、欧洲和日本在 PDH 信令上采用了 3 种完全不同的体系结构。欧洲标准在每个数据流中塞入了更多信道 (约 2 Mbps 的“E1”) ，并且在每个层级之间严格采用了整齐划一的 4 倍复用率。欧洲的 PDH 实践甚至获得了国际电报电话咨询委员会 (CCITT) 的完整正式标准背书。而日本系统虽然采用了与美国相同的 DS1 基准，但其每一级的复用倍数却大相径庭 (为 4、5、3、4，而不是美国的 4、7、6) 。因此，在没有把全部信号彻底拆解重新复用之前，各国的 PDH 系统根本无法直接用于国际长途通话。 > The problem was even bigger when you looked overseas: AT&T tended to field the best thing that Bell Labs and Western Electric could come up with, and then promulgate that as a standard later on. The European telcos tended not to adopt new American developments until they were mature, giving them the opportunity to make standards before any equipment was in place. Thus the European versions of US telephone carriers are often a bit better, and PDH is no exception. In fact, the US, Europe, and Japan used three different hierarchies for PDH signaling. The European standard put more channels into a stream (the "E1" at about 2 Mbps), and used a consistent multiplier of 4 for each level. European PDH practices even got a complete published standard from CCITT. The Japanese system used the same DS1 standard as the US but with different multipliers (4, 5, 3, 4 instead of 4, 7, 6). PDH could thus not be used for international calling without completely remuxing everything. PDH 的另一个严重短板同样与这种“重新复用”有关。由于采用了将各输入帧按比特逐位交叉交织、动态塞入填充比特、并在交织流中插入比特填充标志位的设计，导致 PDH 复用器实际上将各路输入数据流彻底打乱“揉成了浆糊”。假设你手里有一路 DS3 高速数据流，想从中精准提取出一路单独的语音信道，摆在你面前的将是一场工程噩梦。以当年的电子技术水平，想直接在线解析出每一级的交织规律和填充位是根本做不到的。你唯一的办法，就是将这路 DS3 数据流一层一层地经过多台解复用器逐级拆解，一直拆到数字体系的最底层，取出你想要的那路信道，然后再一层一层重新复用封装回去。从一路 DS3 中单独掏出一路信道，甚至可能需要占用两台高达 11.5 英尺 (约 3.5 米) 的庞大设备机柜；而且受制于借位信令机制，这一来一回的拆解与重构还会进一步恶化量化噪声。 > Another shortcoming of PDH had to do with that remuxing. The decision to bit-interleave the input frames together, stuff some bits, and then put flags on the bit stuffing into the interleaved stream, meant that a PDH multiplexer effectively "scrambled" the input streams. If you had, say, a DS3 stream and wanted to extract a single voice channel from it, you had a lot of work in front of you. It simply wasn't feasible with the electronics of the era to analyze the stream to determine the interleaving and stuffing bits at each level. Instead, you would have to put the DS3 through demuxers all the way back down to the bottom of the hierarchy, pull out the channel you wanted, and then remux it all the way back up. Pulling a single channel out of a DS3 could require two 11.5 foot tall equipment bays, and even further quantization noise due to the nature of the robbed bit scheme. 后来发生的两件大事将 PDH 推向了极限：首先是光纤技术的到来。众所周知，AT&T 在光纤技术的接纳上显得相当保守迟钝；70 年代关于数字体系的官方文献中，通篇都在讨论如何通过 T 载波、微波和同轴电缆来进行传输。我们之前曾[探讨过同轴电缆](https://computer.rip/2021-12-13-coaxial-goes-to-war.html)，但当时的 L 载波是一套纯模拟系统。虽然数字同轴电缆后来也演进出了 T3、T4 和 T5 等载波，但它们的传输距离相对较短，主要仅用于局间较近距离的短途互联。 > Two things happened that pushed PDH to its limit: first, fiber optics. AT&T was famously a late adopter of fiber, and 1970s documents on the digital hierarchy talked about conveying it over T-carrier, microwave, and coaxial. We have [talked about coaxial before](https://computer.rip/2021-12-13-coaxial-goes-to-war.html), but L-carrier was an analog system. AT&T dipped their toe in the water in 1976, with an experimental DS3 fiber optic link in Atlanta. Sparing the (fascinating) story of the business and competitive factors, the writing was on the wall: fiber was the future of long lines. One of the shortcomings of PDH was its lack of international standardization, and SONET would not make the same mistake. Shortly after SONET was proposed to ANSI, it was also proposed to CCITT. For historic reasons, and despite the fact that they are largely identical, SONET (Synchronous Optical Network) is a North American standard while the European standard is called SDH, for Synchronous Digital Hierarchy. I will stick to the term SONET because it is catchier, but the name SDH better conveys that SONET is essentially the same idea as PDH but it's actually synchronous. Beyond that, it is also more feature-rich and much better standardized. That means that it is practical to inspect a high-rate SONET link, find a specific channel, and pull out those bits. You can even find where a channel is located and then overwrite just those bits, inserting data into the stream. This pattern is called "add-drop multiplexing," because the multiplexer usually adds some channels and drops others. 让我们来看一个真实的生动案例。许多年前，我曾在弗吉尼亚州的一家通用电气 (General Electric) 工厂实习。虽然当时厂区的主要互联网连接已经升级，但为了提供灾备冗余以及支持一套老旧的时分复用专用分组交换机 (TDM PABX) ，厂区内的 SONET 专线依然保持着活跃运行。在机房里，一台产权归属于电信运营商的分插复用器端坐在机柜中，与光纤配线箱紧挨在一起，整栋大楼的光纤就是在这里熔接并入环网的。这台复用器充当了用户端驻地设备 (CPE) ；我们的 Cisco 路由器通过光载波 (OC) 光纤连接到复用器的“低速端”，而其“高速端”则分别向顺逆两个方向引出两条连接，通向环网上的“左邻右舍”。电信工程师在机柜上贴了一张手绘拓扑图，上面清清楚楚地标明了去向：一对光纤连向了美国国家射电天文台 (National Radio Astronomy Observatory) ，另一对光纤则通往了美国国家地理空间情报局 (National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency) 。可想而知，那条环网上当年流淌的数据该有多么惊心动魄！ > Let's work a concrete example. Many years ago, I was an intern at a General Electric plant in Virginia. Although the facility's main internet connectivity had since been upgraded, SONET service was still active for redundancy and for a legacy TDM PABX. In an equipment room, the telco-owned add-drop multiplexer sat in a rack with the fiber enclosures where the building was actually spliced into the ring. The multiplexer was the customer premises equipment, and our Cisco router was connected by OC fiber to the multiplexer's "low speed" side while its "high speed" side had two connections, one each way, to our "neighbors" on the ring. The telco had left a diagram taped to the rack that made this material: one pair of fibers went to the National Radio Astronomy Observatory, the other went to the National Geospatial Intelligence Agency. There must have been some interesting traffic on that ring! 复用器精准抓取 SONET 环网中预先分配给我们厂区的特定时隙，“下路分出”这些比特并通过低速接口发送出去；与此同时，它接收来自低速侧的待发数据，并将其“插入”回相同的时隙中继续环流。环网上的每个机构节点都对属于自己的信道执行着完全相同的分插操作。 > The multiplexer found the time slots in the SONET ring that were assigned to us, "dropped" them and sent those bits out on the low-speed side, and then received bits on the low-speed side that were "added" back into the same time slots. Each of the organizations along the ring did the same thing with their own channels. SONET 环网必须实体物理“穿过”每一个客户节点的特点，也带来了一个实质性的潜在短板：因为一旦某家客户现场的分插复用器发生硬件故障，就可能殃及池鱼，导致环上其他客户的服务遭受波及中断。这正是为什么复用器必须被界定为运营商的直属资产，也是为什么 SONET 环网在部署时必须严格配备某种形式的自动保护与冗余倒换机制的原因。即便如此，电话公司的运维技术人员仍免不了隔三差五登记出现在大楼保安门禁处，申请进入机房对现场的 SONET 设备进行例行巡检或抢修排障。 > The fact that the SONET ring had to "pass through" each of its users was a material downside, since a failure of an add-drop multiplexer at one customer could cause service disruptions for others. That's why the multiplexer was telco property, and further why SONET rings were always deployed with some type of automatic protection and redundancy. Ultimately, though, a telephone company technician still showed up at the security desk from time to time, needing to perform maintenance or repairs on the SONET equipment. 在 SONET 链路任意节点执行分插复用的非凡能力，还进一步孕育了数字交叉连接 (Digital Cross-Connects, DXC) 技术。至此，全美统一纯数字通信网络的宏伟蓝图终于得以成为现实：通过将两台分插复用器背靠背配对联动，你可以在两条不同的 SONET 传输线之间，以纯数字方式无缝交换信道，而且几乎零附加延迟。辅以名为事务语言 1 (Transaction Language 1, TL1) 的远程管理重构协议，数字交叉连接让长途通信骨干网获得了前所未有的超高弹性调度能力。海量的长途通信流量可以在毫秒间瞬间重路由，既能灵活归并汇聚到核心干线上，也能在需要时平滑分散到次级线路上。 > The ability to perform add-drop multiplexing at any point on a SONET link also enabled digital cross-connects. This, finally, was the original dream of the nationwide digital network: by pairing two add-drop multiplexers together, you can switch channels from one SONET line onto another, completely digitally and with almost no latency. Paired with a management protocol called Transaction language 1 (TL1) for remote reconfiguration, digital cross connects make the long distance network vastly more flexible. Big chunks of long distance traffic could be instantly rerouted, and consolidated onto major routes or spread across more minor ones. 读到这里你可能会问，困扰通信界多年的时钟同步顽疾究竟是如何被化解的呢？PDH 与 SONET 最本质的区别就在于：PDH 是“准同步”的，而 SONET 是真正的“全同步”。SONET 强制要求其互联网络内部的所有终端设备必须保持绝对严格的步调一致。而这恰恰是当年 PDH 竭力回避并推辞的硬性条件。这背后的转机在于：授时与同步领域的技术水平已经取得了跨越式突破。 > Now, you might wonder, what happened to the whole synchronization problem? The most obvious difference between PDH and SONET is that PDH is plesiochronous while SONET is synchronous. SONET requires that all of the terminals, at least within a given interconnected network, operate in synchronization. That's exactly the requirement that PDH rejected. What changed is the state of the art in timing and synchronization. 多项技术的交汇融合彻底终结了准同步方案的历史使命。首先是贝尔系统基准频率 (Bell System Reference Frequency) 的引入：为了统一协同调度对时间极度敏感的模拟与数字系统，AT&T 搭建了一套覆盖全美的统一时间同步网络。到了 20 世纪 80 年代，2048 kHz 的贝尔系统基准频率已通过长途骨干网络分发至几乎所有核心电信机房。随后，各类先进的时间码体制接踵而至。与此同一时期，全球定位系统 (GPS) 投入全面组网运行，高精度 GPS 接收机迅速成为了一种极其经济可靠的精密时间基准源。 > A few things came together to obsolete the need for plesiochronous technology. One was the introduction of the Bell System Reference Frequency: to coordinate both analog and digital systems that were timing-sensitive, AT&T introduced a nationwide time synchronization system. By the 1980s, the 2048 kHz Bell System Reference Frequency was distributed to nearly all telephone facilities over the long distance infrastructure. Various time code systems followed. During the same period, GPS was coming online, and GPS receivers became a relatively inexpensive source of precise time. 在 SONET 环网中，大多数从属终端设备直接从光纤环网接收的信号中提取时钟节拍：它们只需跟随时钟脉冲，在约定的精准时刻执行信道的分插操作。而通常位于电信交换枢纽局的“主控 (master) ”终端，则负责保持全网统一的时钟心跳。在早期阶段，主终端通常从中心机房内的原子钟或者从上级枢纽局传来的基准参考信号中派生时钟。而在 SONET 发展的中后期，时间基准源普遍升级为“大楼综合定时供给系统 (Building Integrated Timing Supply, BITS) ”。BITS 本质上就是电信机房的“专用时间服务器”，它通常以机房楼顶的高精度 GPS 接收机作为主驯服基准源，并向机房内所有需要精准对时的网络设备广播输出不同格式的时分复用 (TDM) 时间码。 > Most terminals on a SONET ring got their timing from the ring: they just followed the signal and added or dropped channels at the appropriate time. A "master" terminal, typically at the telephone exchange, had to maintain that beat. In the early days, it would likely derive its clock either from an atomic clock in the office or via a reference signal coming from another office. In the later days of SONET, the time source was more likely to be a "BITS" or Building Integrated Timing Supply. BITS are basically time servers for telephone offices, typically using a GPS receiver as their discipline source and transmitting a few different types of TDM time codes to whatever devices needed them. 有趣的是，尽管拥有了如此严密的授时体系，SONET 依然在协议底层保留了一点“作弊”后手。系统内依然留有*微量*的容差游隙。SONET 协议开销中专门设计了一个“指针 (pointer) ”，用于精确指示数据载荷在当前传输帧内的实际起始字节偏移量。这样一来，当出现偶发的微小频率漂移时，SONET 设备可以在帧内稍微向后推迟净荷的起始位置，从而从容消化并抚平微弱的时钟误差。这一指针调整机制意味着，即使在尚未实现绝对同步的准同步网络环境中，SONET 依然能够稳健运行，这也极大地加速了从 PDH 向 SONET 的全行业平滑过渡进程。 > Despite all of these measures, it's interesting that SONET still cheats. There *is* a bit of wiggle room. Part of the SONET protocol overhead is a pointer that indicates the offset within the frame that the payload frame actually starts. SONET devices can thus start the payload a little bit late in a SONET frame, providing an opportunity to fix timing errors. This capability means that SONET is still an option even in plesiochronous environments, which eased the fairly rapid transition from PDH to SONET. --- ## SONET 实践：巅峰辉煌与走向黄昏 > ## SONET in Use SONET 的传输速率足够快，以至于它一直顽强存活到了现代，尽管如今它已无可争议地被归入“老旧遗留系统 (legacy) ”的行列。38 Gbps 的吞吐量绝非等闲之辈，即便是放在今天，与许多常见的长途链路相比依然毫不逊色。SONET 真正暴露其岁月痕迹的地方，在于它所承载的实际网络净荷。在现实世界中，人们究竟会在 SONET 环网上跑什么业务呢？ > SONET is fast enough to survive into the modern era, although it is now decidedly legacy. 38 Gbps is nothing to sneeze at, and still compares favorably with a lot of common long distance connections. Where SONET shows its age is in the actual network payload. What do you actually put on a SONET ring? 显而易见，你可以在 SONET 的任何一个速率层级中塞入海量的 64 Kbps 电话信道。你可以直接跑“原生”的 T1 信号，也可以借助综合业务数字网 (ISDN) 来传输——后者运行在相同的底层光信号上，但对电话信令 (如摘机状态) 和互操作性给出了更规范的标准化定义。然而，即便是最低档的 OC-1 也拥有多达 672 个语音信道，这远远超出了绝大多数企业日常通话的实际需求。在 20 世纪 80 年代，推动商业 SONET 专线业务发展的真正发动机是——数据通信。 > Well, of course, you can fit a whole lot of 64 Kbps telephone channels onto any of the SONET tiers. You can do that using a "raw" T1 signal or via ISDN, which uses the same basic fiber signals but better standardizes telephone signaling (e.g. off hook status) and interoperability. But even an OC-1 has 672 channels, more phone calls than just about anyone needs to make. In the 1980s, the driver for commercial SONET service was data. SONET 本身表现出了惊人的“协议中立性”——它之所以采用那种奇特的分帧结构，原因之一就是它对上层协议帧的大小、速率和定时特性完全不敏感、一视同仁。从本质上讲，SONET 将所有连接都视作不透明的透明串行比特流；因此在概念上，你几乎可以在它上面承载任何类型的网络协议。 > SONET itself is incredibly protocol neutral—one of the reasons for its unusual framing structure is that it is agnostic to the size, rate, and timing of the frames of the next layer protocol. SONET basically treats all connections as opaque serial streams, so conceptually, you can put just about anything over it. 由于 SONET 与 ISDN 诞生于同一时代，两者之间有着千丝万缕的联系。在 80 年代末 SONET 铺开建设的过程中，“宽带 ISDN (B-ISDN) ”计划催生了异步传输模式 (Asynchronous Transfer Mode, ATM) 。ATM 是一种虚电路交换协议，它将大量微小且固定尺寸的数据分组 (称为信元，cells) 复用到诸如 SONET 之类的高速连接上。ATM 曾经一度被视作统治广域网 (WAN) 的最强种子选手。然而历史并未如其所愿，IP 协议最终横扫天下并接管了一切——但在那之前，ATM 已经建立起了深厚的根基，以至于通过 ATM 承载 IP 成为了极具吸引力的主流过渡方案。IP over ATM 曾极为普及，事实上直到不久前，它依然是绝大多数数字用户线路 (DSL) 宽带的底层标准规范。 > Because SONET evolved during the same period as ISDN, the two are closely related. During the late '80s, as SONET was being deployed, the "Broadband ISDN" initiative created Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM). ATM is a virtual circuit switching protocol that multiplexes a large number of small, fixed-size packets (called cells) over high-speed connections like SONET. ATM was, at one time, a serious contender for the dominant protocol in wide area networks. That didn't come to be, though, and IP took over—but not before ATM was well-enough established to be a tempting way to carry IP. IP over ATM was fairly common, and in fact, remained the norm for DSL until fairly recently. 当然，业内还有其他共存的承载方案：光纤上的分组传输 (Packet over SONET, POS) 是一套基于 SONET 运行的点对点协议 (PPP) 标准，它几乎能打包封装任何协议，但主要被用来高效搬运 IP 数据包。而后来更为现代化的方案则是以太网透传 SONET (Ethernet over SONET, EoS) ，顾名思义，它直接将以太网数据帧无缝封装映射进 SONET 链路中。 > There were other options as well: Packet over SONET was a standard for SONET-based PPP connections, which could carry just about anything but were often used for IP. A newer offering is Ethernet over SONET, which does exactly what it sounds like. 互联网的爆发为 SONET 提供了极其广阔的应用舞台，但同时也给它带来了空前严峻的范式挑战。SONET 是由传统电话工业一手孕育打造的，其设计哲学极度推崇以极高的可靠性和极低的延迟来处理固定速率的刚性信道。然而基于 IP 的互联网却走向了完全相反的哲学：在相对高延迟且尽力而为 (缺乏绝对可靠性保障) 的信道上，见缝插针、投机式地传输可变速率的突发数据流。这种底层理念的剧烈冲突，使得在 SONET 上跑互联网业务变得越来越格格不入。 > The internet provided a compelling use-case for SONET, but it also became a challenge. SONET was designed within the telephone industry, which emphasized handling fixed-speed channels with very high reliability and very low latency. The IP-based internet embraced the opposite: opportunistically moving variable speed connections over relatively high-latency and low-reliability channels. That meant that internet service over SONET became awkward. 其一，它往往显得不够快且昂贵。根源在于带宽分配机制：在 SONET 环网上获得通信时间意味着独占分配特定信道，无论你实际用不用，你都必须为这些信道 7×24 小时支付全额租费。虽然业界后来研发了一种名为虚级联 (Virtual Concatenation, VCAT) 的技术，允许将 SONET 的低阶构建单元 (如 STS-1) 任意捆绑组合，以拼凑出用户所需的任何带宽规格；但在 SONET 上划分出来的每一兆带宽，都是其他客户绝对无法共享分毫的物理专有带宽。你必须为之实打实买单。再后来，人们也研发出了动态可变带宽分配系统，但这些机制实现过于繁复，并且早已错失了扭转乾坤的最佳历史窗口期。 > For one, it tended to be slow. The reason was bandwidth allocation: getting time on a SONET ring means getting channels assigned, and you will pay for those channels 24/7 regardless of whether or not you use them. A technology called virtual concatenation was developed to allow SONET's lower-level building blocks (like STS-1) to be combined in arbitrary ways to produce just about any amount of bandwidth you could want, but every Mbps over SONET was an Mbps that couldn't be used by any other customer. You paid for it. Later on, variable-bandwidth allocation systems were developed, but they were complex and missed the opportunity to make much of a difference. SONET 刚性固定的带宽设计让它在传输实时流媒体方面游刃有余——这向来是电信工业的拿手好戏。但充满讽刺意味的是，在早期的信息技术革命中，实时多媒体通信却在相当长一段时间内缺席了：当时的普通互联网连接普遍太慢且太不可靠，根本无法承载流畅的音视频互动。而当实时媒体真正王者归来时，IP 网络的连接速率已经飙升到如此之快，以至于凭借排山倒海般的蛮力带宽，就足以彻底抹平缺乏精细化流量工程调度的缺陷。“慢速但绝对可靠”，在与“飞速但并不绝对完美”的残酷商业竞争中，几乎全盘溃败。 > SONET's fixed-bandwidth design made it excellent for real-time media, the wheelhouse of the telephone industry, but ironically real-time media was missing from the information revolution. Internet connections were generally too slow and unreliable to carry it. By the time real-time media returned, IP connections had gotten so fast that they could make up for the lack of traffic engineering with raw speed. Slow and reliable lost out to fast and unreliable almost every time. 此外，SONET 身上也背负着传统电信行业网络架构所有的典型痼疾。到了 20 世纪 90 年代，基于 IP 的网络设备不仅成本远低于复杂的 ATM 和 SONET 硬件，而且在配置和运维上也简单得多。新兴的互联网服务提供商 (ISP) 怀揣着强烈的颠覆动力，凭借低成本的非 SONET 架构大打价格战，迅速将专线通信资费拉下了神坛。 > SONET also had all the typical warts of a telephone industry network architecture. By the '90s, IP-based network equipment was both cheaper and easier to use than ATM and SONET devices. Upstart internet service providers were much more competitively motivated, driving down prices on non-SONET services. 在标准演进的舞台上，SONET 最终被光传送网 (Optical Transport Network, OTN) 所全面接替。OTN 是由国际电信联盟 (ITU) 制定的新一代数字体系标准，其起始速率从 2.5 Gbps 起步，向上延伸——只要物理工艺允许，理论上速率可以任意叠加攀升。如今，高达 800 Gbps 的“OTUC8”已正式投入商用。除了拥有高耸入云的带宽速率，OTN 的架构设计还能以远比前辈高得多的效率，轻松适配以太网等变长数据分组传输。当然，即便强如 OTN，如今在数据中心与城域互联的激战中，也正在面临直接将以太网数据帧裸奔打上光纤 (如彩光直连) 等极端扁平化方案的猛烈冲击。 > SONET has been superseded as a standard by OTN, Optical Transport Network. OTN is an ITU standard for a digital hierarchy that starts at 2.5 Gbps and goes up, well, as high as you want. 800 Gbps "OTUC8" is now in service. Besides being faster, OTN is also designed to accommodate variable packet connections like Ethernet much more efficiently. And, of course, even OTN is losing the fight against schemes that carry Ethernet frames directly over fiber. --- ## 脚注与参考文献 > ## Footnotes 1. 这是否是 8 比特字节 (byte) 在现代计算机领域变得如此普遍的根源所在？坦白说我并不能完全确定，这会是未来一项绝佳的研究课题。很久以前，我在另一个博客中曾花费大量时间试图考证当今无处不在的 8 位字长的真正起源谱系。如果不投入毕生学术生涯去专门深挖这一历史课题，我想我所能给出的最中肯结论是：当年似乎存在多条平行的技术演进脉络，最终不约而同地收敛到了将 7 比特和 8 比特视为通信传输的最佳位宽选择。而数字电话通信设备的发展，毫无疑问是其中极其关键的一条核心支脉。 [^1] > 1. Is this the reason that 8-bit bytes became so universal in computing? I genuinely do not know, this would be a good topic for future research. A long time ago, on a different blog, I spent some time trying to establish the lineage of the 8-bit word length that is now so universal. Without devoting a career of research to the topic, I think the best I can say is that there seem to have been several parallel paths that converged on 7 and 8 bits as good choices for communications purposes. Digital telephony equipment was certainly one of them. [^1] 2. 如果有哪位深谙此道的读者掌握相反的内幕史料，我将非常感激您能不吝赐教。 [^2] > 2. And I would very much appreciate information from anyone who knows otherwise. [^2] [^1]: 这是否是 8 比特字节在计算领域变得如此普及的原因？作者在此探讨了 7 比特与 8 比特作为通信最佳选择的收敛历史。 [^2]: 作者欢迎掌握 Western Electric 独立 PDH 复用器历史证据的读者提供进一步指正。

item.title: 从 SGD 到 Muon：基于 Schatten-p 范数的逐层自适应几何优化器
item.link: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-13/从-SGD-到-Muon-基于-Schatten-p-范数的自适应优化器几何结构/
item.guid: https://insight.aitobox.com/blog/posts/2026-10-13/从-SGD-到-Muon-基于-Schatten-p-范数的自适应优化器几何结构/
item.description:
在深度学习模型的训练演进中，从经典的 SGD、Adam 到近期凭借矩阵谱范数优化大放异彩的 **Muon**，优化器正经历着从“标量元素独立更新”向“矩阵整体几何约束”的深刻范式迁移。然而，以 Muon 为代表的优化器虽然通过线性极小化预言机 (Linear Minimization Oracle, LMO) 实现了显著的收敛加速，其几何约束却往往是由设计者人为固化或经验设定的，无法适应神经网络中不同网络层各异的损失曲面与特征结构。针对这一局限，Thomas Massena 等人创新性地基于 Schatten-p 范数构建起一套数据驱动的逐层自适应几何优化框架，通过单步随机特征回归代理模型从激活与梯度统计中动态推导出最优闭式解，不仅优雅地在 SGD 与 Muon 之间构建起平滑连续的光谱，更将 SGD、Adam、Muon 及 MuAdam 全面纳为极端特例。令人瞩目的是，该算法在实现逐层动态几何自适应的同时，仅引入约 $3\%$ 的极低额外运行时开销，在多种严苛训练基准下均展现出顶尖的收敛效率与泛化表现，为大模型下一代自适应优化架构的设计提供了极具突破性的理论与工程范式。
---
## 内容概要
> ## Summary
以 **Muon** 为代表的现代深度学习优化器，通过线性极小化预言机 (Linear Minimization Oracle, LMO) 理论，为权重更新引入了矩阵层面的几何约束，显著加速了模型的收敛步伐。然而，现有的前沿方法在设计更新几何结构时，往往依赖预设的静态规则或经验调优，导致所有网络层都只能采用一刀切的固定几何约束；这种静态设定很难精确契合神经网络各层之间截然不同的实际特征几何与损失曲面。
> Modern deep learning optimizers like **Muon** impose matrix-wise geometry constraints on their updates through Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO) theory. However, these methods typically use static, by-design, or empirically chosen update geometries that may not align with the specific geometry of individual neural network layers.
针对这一痛点，本文提出了一种数据驱动的动态评判准则，能够为神经网络的每一个层单独挑选最理想的代理更新 LMO 几何结构。作者团队利用单步随机特征回归代理模型 (Surrogate Model) ，从各层的梯度与激活值统计信息中推导出了优雅的解析闭式解，使该框架能够在 **SGD** 与 **Muon** 的参数更新模式之间实现无缝平滑插值。更进一步，通过引入逐参数的预条件处理 (Parameter-wise Preconditioning) ，该理论框架成功构建起一套大一统视角，将经典的 **SGD**、**Muon**、**Adam** 以及 **MuAdam** 均涵盖为其在特定极限条件下的特例。得益于极为精简高效的计算策略，该自适应机制仅带来约 $3\%$ 的极低运行时开销 (Runtime Overhead) ，便在多种复杂训练场景中展现出媲美甚至超越现有最优基准模型 (Baselines) 的亮眼战绩，为深度学习优化器迈向全动态、运行时逐层自适应几何结构开辟了崭新纪元。
> This paper introduces a data-driven criterion that dynamically selects proxy-optimal update LMO geometries per layer. Derived in closed form from gradient and activation statistics using a single-step random feature regression surrogate model, the proposed framework seamlessly interpolates between **SGD** and **Muon** updates. By integrating parameter-wise preconditioning, it generalizes and recovers **SGD**, **Muon**, **Adam**, and **MuAdam** as specific limiting cases. With efficient computational strategies yielding only a ~3% runtime overhead, the method demonstrates competitive or superior performance compared to the best-performing baselines across multiple training scenarios, paving the way for dynamic, runtime-adapted optimizer geometries.
---
